name: Senir's Observations
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
I was planning on sending my apprentice to my brother Senir with my report, but I would feel much better were it placed in more... reliable hands. That is, of course, if you wouldn't mind?

Hmm... you'll have to take the tunnel to get to Kharanos.

Speak with Mountaineer Thalos before going through the tunnel. It's completely infested with troggs now.

Follow the road back to Anvilmar, then keep heading east to the tunnel, Thalos is stationed nearby.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Hm, well, if Whitebeard is sending you to Dun Morogh on important business, I can't very well stop you, can I?

At least let me provide you with some advice and directions.
narrative.requestItemsText:
Hail! Have a care, adventurer, the tunnel to Dun Morogh is infested with troggs and is not safe for travel.

If you haven't any pressing business in Dun Morogh, I'll have to ask you to remain in Anvilmar until the tunnel is safer.

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 4 to 10, 2,610 XP in all.

quests.name: The Troll Cave
quests.objectiveText: Grelin Whitebeard would like you to kill 14 Frostmane Troll Whelps.

quests.name: The Stolen Journal
quests.objectiveText: Grelin Whitebeard wants you to kill Grik'nir the Cold, and retrieve his journal.

quests.name: Senir's Observations
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Grelin's report to Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.

quests.name: Frostmane Hold
quests.objectiveText: Explore Frostmane Hold, and kill 5 Frostmane Headhunters for Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.

quests.name: The Reports
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Senir's report to Senator Barin Redstone in Ironforge.
